discovery_source: mondragon.edu official masters catalogue https://www.mondragon.edu/es/masteres-universitarios (26 official masters enumerated)
notes: STRONG DOUBLE MATCH: AB (data analysis) + AC (cloud computing) in one official title — arguably the best single AC-bearing official master found in this slice. INSTITUTION CATALOGUE: 26 másteres universitarios oficiales enumerated from https://www.mondragon.edu/es/masteres-universitarios (Escuela Politécnica Superior, Facultad de Empresariales, Humanidades y Ciencias de la Educación, Basque Culinary Center); a 27th, Sistemas Embebidos, is linked from the postgrado page. Mondragon's títulos propios catalogue at https://www.mondragon.edu/es/formacion-profesionales-postgrados/oferta-completa is JavaScript-rendered and returned no server-side content — TÍTULOS PROPIOS NOT ENUMERATED (see blockers). Programme facts from page: 'Titulación Oficial'; 90 ECTS / 1.5 years; Campus Arrasate-Mondragón; 30 plazas; Idiomas: Castellano, Inglés (mixed — split not stated, do NOT assume English delivery); Presencial; dual itinerary with 2 days classroom + 2.5 days PAID company placement from the start of the course, third semester entirely in company (relevant to funding). ADVANCED STANDING / COMPLEMENTOS: page states 'Dirigido a alumnado en posesión de Títulos universitarios oficiales del ámbito de la Informática (SIN COMPLEMENTOS), Telemática, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica y otros' — i.e. a computing degree is admitted WITHOUT complementos de formación. Directly relevant to the candidate's software engineering background; recognition of the extra 60 ECTS beyond 240 is a separate question and was NOT FOUND. HEADLINE PRICE PUBLISHED: 10.920€ (1er año) + 5.460€ (2º año), stated as 'Importe anual 2026-2027 / Para estudiantes de la Unión Europea' at https://www.mondragon.edu/es/informacion/becas-ayudas/precios-masteres-universitarios , with the caveat 'Previsión para el curso 2026-27. Será ratificado por el Consejo Rector en julio de 2026'. NON-EU RATE: NOT FOUND — the table is explicitly captioned for EU students only and no non-EU column is published, so a non-EU surcharge cannot be ruled out and must be asked about directly. Accessed 2026-08-24.
